description: The page describes the node-level query timeout as 'specified when starting the query engine', a start-up/command-line framing that predates the node-level settings API. In 8.0, node-level Query settings including timeouts are set at runtime via POST /admin/settings (documented in the Query Admin REST API table on intro.md in the same directory) and cluster-wide via POST /settings/querySettings. The page describes a configuration mechanism the current documentation set no longer presents as primary.
